content: {"paper_id":"W1994040806","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"hyperspectral-images","exact_quote":"Hyperspectral Image Restoration Using Low-Rank Matrix Recovery","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"论文标题直接以高光谱图像为处理对象，研究其恢复问题。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"By lexicographically ordering a patch of the HSI into a 2-D matrix, the low-rank property of the hyperspectral imagery is explored, which suggests that a clean HSI patch can be regarded as a low-rank matrix.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确将HSI图像块视为低秩矩阵，并利用低秩性质构建LRMR恢复框架，属于显式低秩建模。"},{"keyword_id":"data-imputation-recovery","exact_quote":"This paper introduces a new HSI restoration method based on low-rank matrix recovery (LRMR), which can simultaneously remove the Gaussian noise, impulse noise, dead lines, and stripes.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文目标是从含高斯噪声、脉冲噪声、坏线和条纹等污染观测中恢复高光谱图像，符合数据补全与恢复任务。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
